#include <assert.h>

#include <stdio.h>

#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"highlight_style\":\"DoubleEqual\"}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<p>Text with <mark>highlighted</mark> here.</p>", options_handle);
